description: This PHP source file defines a helper class for parsing PROPFIND request bodies in a WebDAV server implementation. It handles XML parsing to extract properties requested in WebDAV PROPFIND requests, including options for retrieving all properties, property names, or specific properties.

classes.name: _parse_propfind
classes.description: Helper class for parsing WebDAV PROPFIND request bodies, handling XML input to identify requested properties or modes (all properties, property names, or specific properties).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads input from a specified file path, and parses the XML content to determine requested WebDAV properties.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing, determines the type of property request based on element name and nesting level.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, primarily used to manage nesting depth.
